card.name: The word frequency and its relatives
card.fires_on: The word frequency (or frequencies, -frequency, MHz, frequently, often) when it refers to how often something occurs or to a signal or oscillation rate. It appears in physics, electronics and medical text.

modes.label: Signal or wave frequency
modes.description: Frequency as an oscillation rate in physics or electronics, including MHz and radio-frequency.

modes.label: How often something occurs
modes.description: Frequency or often used for how commonly an event occurs, including in medical text.
